description: Manage a vendor's sub-records (editor+): create, update or delete a certification, a compensating control, or an action item. Deletes are destructive. Pick with method.

category.description: Free-text category, e.g. 'contractual', 'technical' Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

cc_id.description: Compensating control UUID — obtain from scf_list_compensating_controls Used by: update_compensating_control, delete_compensating_control.

cert_id.description: Certification UUID — obtain from scf_list_vendor_certifications Used by: update_certification, delete_certification.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number Used by: create_certification, update_certification.

certification_body.description: Issuing body Used by: create_certification, update_certification.

certification_name.description: Certification name, e.g. 'ISO 27001:2022' Used by: create_certification, update_certification.

compensating_control.description: The control that offsets the gap Used by: create_compensating_control, update_compensating_control.

description.description: Action item detail Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

effectiveness_rating.description: Effectiveness (default partial) Used by: create_compensating_control, update_compensating_control.

gap_description.description: The gap the control offsets Used by: create_compensating_control, update_compensating_control.

item_id.description: Action item UUID — obtain from scf_list_vendor_action_items Used by: update_action_item, delete_action_item.

method.description:
create_certification: Record a certification a vendor holds (write — editor role), e.g. ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Type II. Status defaults to valid; track expiry_date so renewals surface.
update_certification: Update a vendor certification (write — editor role). Only passed fields change; use it to mark a certificate expired or revoked, or to record the renewed expiry date.
delete_certification: Delete a vendor certification record (destructive write — editor role). Prefer status=expired or revoked when the history matters.
create_compensating_control: Record a compensating control for a vendor gap (write — editor role): what the gap is, what offsets it, and how effective that is (full, partial or minimal — default partial).
update_compensating_control: Update a vendor compensating control (write — editor role). Only passed fields change: gap description, control text, effectiveness rating, risk-reduction notes.
delete_compensating_control: Delete a vendor compensating control record (destructive write — editor role).
create_action_item: Create a remediation action item against a vendor (write — editor role), typically from an assessment finding. Priority defaults to medium, status to open.
update_action_item: Update a vendor action item (write — editor role). Only passed fields change; set status=completed with completed_date to close it.
delete_action_item: Delete a vendor action item (destructive write — editor role). Prefer status=cancelled when the record should stay visible.

owner_name.description: Owner name Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

owner_user_id.description: Owner — obtain from scf_list_members Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

priority.description: Priority (default medium) [create_action_item] | Priority [update_action_item] Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

risk_reduction_notes.description: How much residual risk this removes Used by: create_compensating_control, update_compensating_control.

scope.description: Certification scope statement Used by: create_certification, update_certification.

status.description: Status (default valid) [create_certification] | Status [update_certification, update_action_item] | Status (default open) [create_action_item] Used by: create_certification, update_certification, create_action_item, update_action_item.

title.description: Action item title Used by: create_action_item, update_action_item.

verification_url.description: Public verification URL Used by: create_certification, update_certification.

name: scf_vendor_record_write
